scope: CPU metric recomputation of unchanged original-scene paired motion7754, 20 states x 3 routes x 4 executors; no new simulation
definition: Euclidean distance between before.eef_xyz_m + action_xyz * 0.05 m and after.eef_xyz_m, identical for all executors; maximum and RMS across the actual controls. This is a one-control commanded-position residual, not distance to a timed reference or task success.
